column1: Hint

When your health is low, 
you're more likely to find
Sweet Milk in boxes.

Laurel Wreath makes your duck
invincible for a short time.

Each duck can transform into
their Synergy form when they
get their synergy skill.

Keep your buddy ducks
surrounding the lead duck.
They'll block enemy attacks!

Sweet Milk is the most delicious
drink in the universe.
It even restores your health!

If you keep failing a stage,
try upgrading your cards.

Helmeted enemies
take reduced damage.

Glowing-eyed enemies
attack faster.

Enemies with a fuse
explode on contact for massive damage.

The shop unlocks free items
every so often.
Don't miss the chance to
collect new duck friends!

Merge 2 max level cards with
the same grade and stars
to create a stronger card!

Draw various duck cards
from the shop.
Try them out in a stage
right away!

Customize your duck with
a variety of gear!

Defeat the Stage 6 boss,
Bubble Queen, to unlock
Endless Duck Challenge mode!

Every duck has its own
unique ability.
Check it out in the
Gear tab!

Complete a gear set to
gain a buff.
Check it out in the
Collection!

No longer need a card?
You can sell it!

Complete homeworks to earn
badges. Badges permanently
boost your stats!

Out of energy? Watch an ad
to refill it instantly!

If you fall in battle,
watch an ad to get back up
right where you left off!

Log in every day and
don't miss your daily
reward!

Complete daily and weekly
homeworks for extra rewards!

Check the Encyclopedia to
see ducks and items you
haven't met yet!

Got too many cards? Sort
them by name, grade,
or level!

Equip a full gear set
to gain a special buff!

Icy terrain is slippery
and makes it harder to
control your movement.

As you play through the
stages, companion slots
open one by one. Build
your own duck squad!
